title: The app that help you to live a normal life again
body: Finch is an excellent way to help you to get yourself to your normal life again. With an lovely pet that you can name and care, quiz, SOS if you need, simple goals like shower or brush your teeth, that depression stoles from us. And is free, if you want to pay you have the premium version with more gift, and if you can’t afford the premium version (like me) they have a program named “guardians” who pay for you the premium version. But if you don’t want it, the free version have no time limits. It’s really amazing. (Sorry, English is not my first language)
author: Caacu91
